name: clawpod-ocr
title: ClawPod OCR
description: Bounded local Korean and English OCR with comparison DOCX reports, a one-call image fast path, detached jobs, provenance, caching, and guarded Ollama correction.
whenToUse: Extract text from bounded PDFs and images locally with optional approved vision correction

system.preflight.description: Compare the current local OCR probe with persisted onboarding verification.

engine.requirements.description: Describe required local OCR tools, versions, languages, and limits without probing.

engine.verify.description: Probe Tesseract 5, kor/eng/osd, and Poppler, then persist exact local onboarding state.

onboarding.status.description: Report exact persisted local and optional Ollama onboarding states.

ollama.verify.description: Verify transport, auth injection, model existence, and usable vision capability.

ocr.start.description: Require currently and persistently verified Tesseract 5 kor/eng/osd, then OCR locally or launch an owned detached worker.

job.status.description: Reconcile owned worker liveness and report checkpoint state.

job.resume.description: Require current persisted engine verification, then continue an interrupted or cancelled owned job from its next unfinished page.

job.cancel.description: Safely terminate only the PID with the persisted owned start identity.

review.prepare.description: Materialize bounded 200 DPI page images and persist an exact digest-bound Ollama transfer intent.

review.start.description: Transfer only the unchanged digest-approved low-confidence page-image intent to verified Ollama vision.

correction.apply.description: Apply only explicitly selected correction IDs or pages into a separate corrected result.

ocr.quick.description: Inspect, OCR, validate, and return one local image in a single bounded invocation.

report.create.description: Create a bounded enterprise Word comparison report from one or more completed owned OCR jobs.
